name: TCS (Tata Consultancy Services)
verdict: Majority-owned by Tata Sons Private Limited (71.76%). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: title and technology partner in the team name and on the front of the Season 12 (2025/26) kit, per Jaguar TCS Racing's launch release (media.jlr.com, 22 Oct 2025) and the club's partners page (jaguar.com). Majority ownership by Tata Sons per Tata Sons' Annual Report 2024-25 (71.76% as at 31 March 2025); Tata Sons is a private company whose group structure the same report describes as 'largely held by philanthropic trusts' — no state stake in the chain. A US EEOC investigation into discrimination allegations (reported by named press in 2025) is pending and is not a finding. No human-rights finding against TCS or Tata Sons identified.
